purpose: Cover the 47 Stage1 Qlib sessions 2011-01-03 through 2011-03-10 before the first 2011-reference FT900 report is safely available; preserve full training calendar rather than compact survivors.
method: Fetch each index-bound official original full-report PDF exactly once, record UTC/HTTP/hash/size, verify printed reference month and release header plus an exact Exhibit 7 Semiconductors row; archive exact bytes and index to NAS with remote hash and scoped restore. Count Stage1 early calendar with native Qlib D.calendar, no prices or labels.
availability_rule: The original report release date, not the reference month, is the source event. Any later factor must use the next safe Stage1 Qlib decision session after release.
stop: Any ambiguous report month, release header or row remains an exception. Three lead-in reports cannot certify full history, historical first-public bytes, feature effectiveness or SOXX excess.
